sources.native: Actual native B winning FPN level/cell/anchor, retina_reg input256x3x3 including convolution zeros2304

trace: Read original _get_bboxes_single return locals and actual topk_inds, reconstruct masks; no new topk, nearest match or altered forward. Replay regression patch and original B output, frozen detector state.
source_scope: B FPN is shared classification/regression, no separate regression tower; native B feature is supervised against final M box, not B correctness.
transform: Separate centered raw full-TRAIN PCA, deterministic sign, fixed256, no whitening; then TRAIN-only mean/std; no VAL fitting or dimension selection.
capacity: Each score logit separate; PCA256 + final M relative size/aspect2 ->258->16->8->1 ReLU plus beta,4290 parameters.
objective: Size max canonical relative long/short error>.10 against offline GT; full TRAIN2558,71 bad; balanced BCE N/(2*Nclass), AdamW.001 weights decay1e-4 clip5.
initialization: Same seed1701 full hidden weights; final weight/bias and beta zero, exact neutral -z. Two smoke steps discarded, fresh initialization.
budget: Each final epoch100,1000 updates, batch256 same seed1701 permutations. No epoch, capacity, PCA or activation search.
roles: Complete TRAIN fitting -> complete VAL development/threshold -> frozen exposed TEST only after VAL pass. No new roles or performance probe.
threshold: One global minimum whole-tie VAL cutoff protecting >=95% correct retention for every domain/video; original policy point separately.
gate: Only native may advance: strict overall same-count and same-CR FA gains over newly retrained midpoint,full_simple,score; group FA nonincrease; same-CR longest FR nonincrease; ties conservative. Failure stops.
safety: GT offline only; boxes, score, output/missing, center/angle flags and old policy frozen. No depth or geometry changes. TEST repeatedly exposed, never selection.
review: Independently replay PCA/normalization/network, per-frame identities, four states/missing, same-count/CR, ties, ranks, thresholds, update budget.
changes: Only feature source with shared PCA recipe and head capacity; old4802-param head is historical, not fair control.
